columns.description: Select the column in the external metadata table that has Barcodes you expect to correspond to those in the input Seurat Object. The selected column will be used to join the external metadata to the existing Seurat Object metadata.
Select columns in external metadata that you want to add to your input Seurat Object's metadata.
You may choose a single column from the External Metadata to visualize. TSNE & UMAP plots colored by this variable will be produced. You may leave this variable blank. Default is blank.

description: This template will merge an external table of cell annotations into an existing Seurat Object's metadata table. The input external metadata table must have a column named "Barcode" that contains barcodes matching those found in the metadata already present in the input Seurat Object. The output will be a new Seurat Object with metadata that now includes the additional columns from the external table.

inputDatasets.description: Select the input external metadata table.

parameters.description: The name of the RDS within the input SO dataset. By default, this name is "seurat_object.rds".
